name: Hivo Connector
description: Connects Drupal to the Hivo digital-asset platform.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 HIVO is a digital asset management platform that is on a mission to unite technology, teams and data across multiple businesses to all work together in a collaborative and secure cloud environment.

 Thousands of brand managers, creatives, IT professionals, developers, engineers and marketers use HIVO every day to create, review, download, approve, share and store digital content. HIVO differentiates itself from competitors by focusing on developing easy to learn and use, design-led and automated user experiences.

 Whether you're sharing content with external agencies, creating a video for social media, writing the brief for a press release, viewing a branded style guide, reviewing a website mockup, requesting approval from a colleague, or starting an automated marketing campaign - it can all be done within the one platform, HIVO.

 Teams that use HIVO:

 
 Improve communication amongst your team and partners; 
 Unlock user collaborations and transparency; 
 Build better emotional connections with customers, partners and stakeholders; 
 Increase the volume and improve the quality of visual communications; 
 Achieve end-to-end brand consistency across all marketing channels and regions; 
 Achieve cost savings on ownership of digital assets; and 
 Capture data and report on user activity and digital asset use. 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 
 Download media from Hivo into Drupal — Choose assets from your Hivo library and add them to your Drupal media library so you can attach them to content, use in layouts, or manage them in Drupal.

 
 
 Upload existing Drupal media to Hivo — Send media that already lives in Drupal (images, videos, etc.) to your Hivo workspace so you can organize, reuse, or distribute them from Hivo.

 
 
 Embed Hivo media via CDN URL — Insert Hivo media into body text or other rich text fields using Hivo’s CDN URLs. CDN embedding must be enabled in your Hivo account for this to work. 

 
 
 Use cases :

 
 
 You keep photos and videos in Hivo and want to pull them into Drupal as media items for articles and pages.

 
 
 You have media in Drupal that you want to back up or reuse in Hivo (e.g. for other channels or teams).

 
 
 When writing content in the editor, you want to embed images or videos from Hivo so they are delivered via Hivo’s CDN (faster delivery, less load on Drupal).

 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Post-Installation 
 After enabling the module:

 
 
 Go to Administration > Hivo Connector ( /admin/hivo-connector ) and login with your Hivo account.

 
 
 To embed Hivo media in rich text, ensure CDN embedding is enabled in Hivo , then add the "Hivo" button to your text format at Administration > Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors .

 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Additional Requirements 
 
 
 Drupal core modules: File , Media , and CKEditor 5 (needed for the Hivo embed button in the editor).

 
 
 Drupal 9, 10, or 11 with PHP 8.0 or higher.

 
 
 A Hivo account.

 
 
 Embed via CDN: In Hivo, CDN embedding must be enabled for your account so that Hivo media can be embedded in Drupal using CDN URLs.

 
 Back to top
